## Engineering Loop
1. Visualize: Understand the root problem before touching code.
2. Engineer: Make the smallest focused change that works.
3. Release: Ship only with verified evidence and clean rollback paths.

## Key Projects
- VER (Visualize, Engineer, Release): Three-phase agent loop with hard evidence gates, delivered as AGENTS.md plus an installer CLI with zero third-party runtime dependencies (https://github.com/PapaBear911/VER).
- OpenTeamQueue: Zero-build offline tournament manager and queue randomizer for racket sports (https://github.com/PapaBear911/OpenTeamQueue).
- MEDIX-MCP: Headless engineering knowledge and repository intelligence platform connecting AI agents to source code, SQL databases, Git repos, and technical documentation.
- SENTINEL: Evidence-driven engineering audit and verification agent.
